project.name: TEN Framework
project.summary: Monorepo for the TEN runtime and real-time conversational AI agents with graph-based extension composition.

agent_entrypoints.purpose: Root-level Codex guidance for the whole monorepo.
Existing repository guidance written for Claude Code.
Deeper guidance for the ai_agents subtree.

focus_areas.name: core_runtime
focus_areas.description: Low-level TEN runtime, internals, bindings, and foundational engine code.

focus_areas.name: reusable_packages
focus_areas.description: Shared TEN apps, extensions, addon loaders, and protocols.

focus_areas.name: ai_agents
focus_areas.description: Primary area for voice assistant examples, extensions, API server, and frontend.

focus_areas.name: tests
focus_areas.description: Runtime smoke tests, manager tests, and utility support code.

features.description: TEN apps are assembled from nodes and connections defined in property.json graphs.
Primary example chains RTC, VAD, ASR, LLM, and TTS into a real-time voice interaction loop.
Provider-specific Python extensions implement modular speech, language, and synthesis behavior.
Go server starts and manages worker processes and exposes lifecycle APIs.
Frontend workspace for interacting with agent examples.
ESP32 client integration demonstrates hardware connectivity for TEN agents.
Comprehensive smoke and integration coverage for runtime message flow and graph behavior.

commands.purpose: Run the default voice assistant stack.

notes: Do not hand-edit generated outputs such as BUILD.gn, compile_commands.json, .ten, or build artifacts.
Many agent changes require coordinated updates across Python code, manifest.json, and property.json.
Some local voice-assistant files are gitignored in this repository, including the example property.json.
